Short_Description: TACTICUS: RAPID FIRE active at max range
Long_Description: Friendly TACTICUS units’ [RAPID FIRE] attacks benefit from [RAPID FIRE] when targeting units up to that attack’s maximum range.

Short_Description:
PHOBOS / SCOUT after SHOOTING:
Stay HIDDEN or Move D6"
If Move: Cannot CHARGE
Long_Description:
When a friendly PHOBOS or SCOUT SQUAD unit has shot:
• Those attacks do not prevent that unit from being hidden.
• Or: That unit can make a normal move up to D6". That unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.

Short_Description:
End MOVEMENT: HIDDEN PHOBOS
Attacks: Re-roll WOUND 1s
Long_Description: At the end of your Movement phase, if a friendly PHOBOS unit is hidden, that unit’s attacks can re-roll wound rolls of 1 until the end of the turn.

Short_Description: After NORMAL MOVE: RANGED lose HEAVY & +1 Hit
Long_Description:
In a turn a friendly GRAVIS unit made a normal move, that unit’s ranged attacks:
• Do not have [HEAVY].
• Have +1 to hit rolls.

Short_Description:
GRAVIS on OBJECTIVE
vs S > T: -1 to Wound
Long_Description: While a friendly GRAVIS unit is within range of an objective, attacks that target that unit with a S greater than that unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.
